Today I wanted to book a grooming appointment for my senior dog because I checked your website and it said that if the dog is a senior, just let me know so they can work at their pace, implying that they do cater to older dogs. They replied that I didn't know that senior dogs should be bathed by the vet to avoid any problems. I responded that I was actually looking for another option so she wouldn't associate bathing with vaccinations and checkups. But if they couldn't do it, they shouldn't advertise a service they don't offer because they refuse to treat senior dogs, even though their website says they work at their pace. It's very wrong of them to advertise a service they can't actually provide.

Overall, the service was just okay. I ordered a VIP package and never received the video (they promised to send it) of the special treatment for my dog. She's a Labrador mix, so her fur isn't long enough for bows on her ears, but they put them on anyway (they didn't even last 5 minutes). They had promised a bandana instead, but that wasn't it. And when I went to pick her up as we were leaving, they applied the selected perfume instead of at the end of her service. I had high expectations, but the experience wasn't very pleasant and didn't justify the price we paid, nor the service from the staff on Friday.
The service was excellent; they made my dog ​​look gorgeous, even adding a little star and perfume. Their service was very kind and friendly. She looked impeccable.

I love taking my dog ​​here because they treat him so well. The facilities are always clean and organized. The staff is very friendly and considerate. My dog ​​comes out clean after his bath, and the use of perfumes is optional. They also offer baths with special shampoos if the dogs have sensitive skin.
